test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 27 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Some plants produce a sticky substance in the stem which is used to prepare gum adhesives. What is the use of this gum to the plant?

options.text: It is a waste product of metabolism.
It helps in the transport of water.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It is a waste product of metabolism**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **sticky substance produced by plants, often referred to as gum or resin,** is generally** a byproduct of metabolism.**
 
• It serves** no essential function for the plant's survival** but may be excreted as a means to dispose of metabolic waste.
 
• Additionally**, it might provide some secondary benefits**, **like sealing wounds** in the plant to prevent infection or deterring herbivores and pathogens.
 
• In addition to being a waste product of metabolism, **gums and resins** can also help plants in **wound healing and protection**.
 
• When a plant's stem is injured, the sticky substance can seal the wound, preventing the entry of pathogens, pests, and excess water loss.
 
• This protective role can be crucial for the plant's survival.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The resins and gums are stored by plant in the old xylem.

 
• Other by-products of plants are latex, resins, and oils.
 
• These by-products are not useful for plants and are stored in barks, stems leaves the plant parts.
 
• These parts shed off after some time.
 
• Main excretory product of the plant is oxygen and carbon dioxide.
 
• Excretion of these gasses takes place through the stomatal pores on leaves.
